schemaDispositions.marker-rename: The payload meaning is already equivalent; migrate the component ID and references.
schemaDispositions.near-shape: The same state is represented with small field or provenance changes.
schemaDispositions.map: The same concern exists but requires enum-to-reference, collection, unit, or lifecycle transformation.
schemaDispositions.merge: Several canonical components become one normalized prototype component.
schemaDispositions.split: One canonical component decomposes into several prototype components or entities.
schemaDispositions.gap: No source-complete prototype owner currently represents the canonical concern.

mechanicDispositions.retain: Keep the rule algorithm and transaction boundary; rebind component IDs and fields.
mechanicDispositions.adapt: Keep useful rule logic, but revise inputs, outputs, validation, and effects for the target state model.
mechanicDispositions.replace: The target ownership or derived-state policy changes the mechanic contract enough to require a new implementation.
mechanicDispositions.defer: Do not migrate the consumer until the target owner is defined.
